title: GERT Project Configuration v1
description: Structural contract for .gert/config.yaml with apiVersion: config/v1. Covers only the fields touched by the tool-packages MVP (.squad/decisions/archive/barbara-tool-packages-architecture-ruling.md, AR-TP-3 / §3.2); other existing keys (defaults, tools.mcp-servers) are carried over as free-form objects pending their own normative schema pass. Validates structure and types only.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema declaration for IDE tooling.

requires.description: Project-level package requirements. Contributes tier-1 tools to the catalog (design/gert/sections/06-tool-runtime.tex §Tool Discovery). Processed in declaration order; project-level entries precede runbook-level entries for the same run. Duplicate 'package' names in this list are PKG-005.

tool-paths.description: Directories scanned (recursively, for *.tool.yaml) in declaration order for tier-2 project tools, before the conventional <workspace>/tools/ location.

defaults.description: Default step settings applied workspace-wide. Not schema-constrained by this document; see design/gert/sections/03-schema-vnext.tex.

tools.description: Legacy tool-related configuration, including 'mcp-servers'. Not schema-constrained by this document; see design/gert/sections/06-tool-runtime.tex §MCP Tool Integration.

package.description: Reverse-DNS package name. URL-shaped names are PKG-004.

version.description: Version constraint in the MVP grammar (design/gert/sections/06-tool-runtime.tex §Version Constraint Grammar). Malformed constraints are PKG-003.

path.description: REQUIRED in the MVP because there is no remote catalog: MUST point at a directory containing gert-package.yaml. Absolute paths are permitted here (workspace-level operator configuration) but are subject to symlink/containment rules and are recorded as an external root when they resolve outside the workspace (PKG-W003). When remote catalogs are introduced post-MVP, this field becomes optional and its absence will mean 'resolve from catalog' — a forward-compatible, non-breaking extension point.
